transkript.t: Modern Bot detection blocks almost every standard web scraper, but this tool bypasses them completely.
Meet Scrapling, an undetectable web scraping framework with over 90,000 stars.
It automates everything from single page extraction to massive distributed crawls.
It features adaptive selectors that do not break when layouts change,
stealth browser routing and built-in AI agent tools.
It gives data engineers unbreakable extraction pipelines.
